memory.description: [YOU] Core content of this memory atom. Stores raw conversation, distilled facts, or internal reasoning depending on type.

type.description: [SYSTEM for raw] raw: unprocessed input, auto-set by system. [YOU for inner/outer] inner: always loaded into agent context. outer: loaded into context only when needed.

time.description: [YOU] Temporal scope. Always include temporal information if present in the fact; do NOT drop dates, durations, or relative times. Prefer absolute time when resolvable from context (e.g. 'in 2018' not 'five years ago' if the session year is known). Use ISO 8601. For ranges, use 'YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD'.If can not solve, use original descrptio like 'two day before Alan was born'. If completely unknown or no need to use time to describe, use empty string ''. Only to the exact unit of time that can be confirmed.
examples: two day before Alan was born

tag.description: [YOU] Array of key-value labels. MUST include at least one 'speaker:<name>'. Other tags from Tag Taxonomy: topic, entity, sentiment, action, state, relation, other. Format: 'key:value'.

source.description: [YOU] IDs of source memories for provenance tracing. Empty for raw type.

changelog.description: [SYSTEM time + YOU content] Version history. Time auto-generated on modification. Content records previous memory value.
